literal: Death even escaping will be achieved, of penance the power to those who have attained.
translation: Even overcoming death will be possible for those who have attained the power of penance.
modern: தவம் செய்வதால் வரும் வலிமையை அடைந்தவர்களுக்கு, மரணத்தை வெல்வதும் சாத்தியமாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the ultimate strength gained through ascetic practice. The word 'nōṟṟal' refers to the endurance and discipline of penance, which grants a profound inner power ('āṟṟal'). For those who have fully attained this power, even the ultimate human limit of death ('kūṟṟam') can be leaped over or overcome. The phrase 'kaikūṭum' literally means joining the hands, signifying that such an extraordinary feat comes easily into their grasp.
